     or new.created_by is distinct from old.created_by

alter table public.emails enable row level security;

-- Anonymous visitors get no privileges at all (R4); authenticated users get
-- the DML the client needs, and RLS below narrows it to their own drafts.
revoke all on public.emails from anon;
grant select, insert, update, delete on public.emails to authenticated;
grant all on public.emails to service_role;

-- R1: users can read their own emails, drafts and sent.
create policy "Users can read their own emails"
  on public.emails
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (user_id = auth.uid());

-- R2 + R3: users can create drafts only, as themselves, never with sent_at.
create policy "Users can create their own drafts"
  on public.emails
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and sent_at is null
  );

-- emails invisible to update; the WITH CHECK clause forbids setting sent_at
-- (or reassigning user_id) on the resulting row.
create policy "Users can edit their own drafts"
  on public.emails
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and sent_at is null
  )
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and sent_at is null
  );

-- R2 + R3: users can delete their own drafts only; sent emails are immutable.
create policy "Users can delete their own drafts"
  on public.emails
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and sent_at is null
  );
